messages:
Maya Chen: Hi all, first-day kit arrived. Dock powers laptop but external monitor says 'No Signal'. Using HDMI on dock. Also USB-A keyboard connected to the dock randomly disconnects every ~20-40s. VPN install never prompted for corp cert and now VPN fails with 'certificate not found'. Should I open a ticket?

Jordan (IT): Welcome Maya! Quick checks: is the monitor set to the right input? Try swapping to DisplayPort if available. For the keyboard, try a different USB-A port (rear vs front). For the cert, did you run the corp VPN installer as admin? Tell me your laptop model.

Maya Chen: Laptop: MacBook Pro 14 (M2, macOS Ventura). Monitor: LG 27UP850. I tried DP -> DP and still no picture. Keyboard is a basic Logitech wired USB-A. When it disconnects, macOS shows USB device removed then reconnected. I didn't run any installer as admin (Mac). VPN installer ran but no cert prompt. Error: "certificate not found" during SSO.

Jordan (IT): On Mac we sometimes need to allow system kernel extensions or give Full Disk Access for VPN helper. Steps: System Settings > Privacy & Security -> look for any blocked extensions -> allow, then reboot. Also check System Report > USB to see if the keyboard shows power cycles. If DP still fails, try a direct USB-C -> DP cable to the monitor bypassing the dock. I'll spin up a ticket to track this.

it-bot: Ticket IT-2101 created by Jordan (IT) for Maya Chen — "New hire: dock passthrough no signal, USB-A keyboard disconnects, VPN cert not provisioning". Priority: P2. ETA triage 1.5 hours.

Sam Patel: Welcome to infra, @Maya :wave: I had this exact Mac + dock issue. In my case the dock firmware was ancient; IT pushed a FW update and DP came up. Also saw the keyboard issue fixed after switching to a powered USB hub. If you're in the NYC office I can drop off a hub.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. I'm remote in NYC. I can try the USB-C->DP cable I have at home and check Privacy & Security. I'm available for a remote session at 3pm ET if that helps.

Jordan (IT): Sounds good — I'll schedule a quick remote support session for 3pm ET and include a link. If we can't fix it we'll ship a replacement dock and a powered USB hub tomorrow morning.
